method: read-only probes and transactions that were rolled back; no value or identifier is stored here

reference_semantics.document_ref_uuid_value_type: COM dispatch object; connection.String(value) gives canonical text

write_requirements.document_own_date_missing: write fails with a generic 'Failed to save' error
write_requirements.document_own_date_set: write succeeds; the document number is assigned on write
write_requirements.enumeration_assigned_as_text: NO error; the document is written and the stored enumeration value is EMPTY (also for a nonsense string)

dates.iso_text_assigned_to_date_attribute: NO error; stored as the empty date
dates.python_datetime_assigned_over_pywin32: converted unpredictably (shifted); never assign Python datetimes
dates.date_built_by_ONisanieTipov_conversion_1: assigned and stored exactly; date-only attribute reads back as YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00 via XMLString
dates.document_own_date_time_of_day: the stored time of day is always 07:00:00 on the clone for assigned times 00:00:00, 01:00:00, 04:30:00, 05:00:00, 12:00:00 and 23:59:59, and the calendar day is always kept (not a fixed offset; the configuration normalizes the time); the reason is UNKNOWN
dates.python_datetime_read_back: tz-shifted; read dates as XMLString text instead

phantom_references_on_write: a document write with a reference to a non-existent element succeeds silently, so the executor must prove existence itself

least_privilege_run.narrow_user_lookup: existing element: get object not None, deletion mark false; random GUID: get object None

totals.includes_vat_flag_default_false: document total = line amount + line VAT amount (20 + 1.82 = 21.82)
